thread:
Elaine: Heads-up — AWS marketplace partner asked for 3 Terraform module flavors (aws-standard, aws-gov, onprem-vpc) plus a vetted CI pipeline and a short compliance preset. They want a deliverable in ~2 weeks. Who can take what? :wave:
Devendra: I can own the module schema and examples. Will create variable/outputs contract and a conformance checklist for marketplace reviewers.
Ash: I can wire up CI — terratest + a lightweight smoke deploy into our partner staging account. Recommendation: name modules like `redwood/partner/<name>/<flavor>` and include `examples/` directories.
Jun: For the onprem flavor we'll need a K8s example (helm+operator) and explicit notes for networking (MTU, overlay MTLS). Also add an `instance_type` map for Arm vs x86 so partner can opt-in to Graviton/Inferentia.
Elaine: Also add a small `policies/` dir with rego snippets and a minimal KMS/CIS preset — partner is in a regulated vertical.
Devendra: Starting a quick template for variable schema. Short snippet for provider pinning that we should include in examples:
```hcl
terraform {
  required_providers {
    aws = {
      source  = "hashicorp/aws"
      version = ">= 4.0, < 5.0"
    }
  }
}

provider "aws" {
  region = var.region
}
```
Ash: I'll add CI jobs: `validate`, `fmt`, `terratest`, and `smoke-deploy`. Draft GitHub Actions snippet I'll push to the repo skeleton. Need a partner-specific test account creds secret (vault path).
Elaine: Good call. For smoke-deploy keep it non-destructive (use `plan` + `apply -target=module.example --auto-approve` in a short-lived env).
infra-bot: Repo created -> https://github.com/redwood/infra-kits/tree/partner-iac-2273456789 :robot_face:
Ash: Pushing `ci/workflows/marketplace.yml` and a terratest scaffold now. Will tag you @Elaine when ready. :thumbsup:
Jun: I'll draft the README + usage examples (aws-standard + aws-gov + onprem) and a short troubleshooting section for common marketplace review flags. ETA EOD Friday.
Devendra: I'll also add a lightweight linter rule for `outputs` naming so reviewers can find endpoint/arn outputs predictably.
Elaine: Thanks — plan for a 30m sync Monday to review the skeleton and CI results. If anything blocks earlier ping here or DM.
Ash: SG.
Jun: 👍
Elaine: Closing the loop — once CI passes we'll prepare the partner-facing asset bundle (module + README + compliance preset + CI badge).
